label: Caboc
note: Rennet-free; formed into a log and rolled in toasted pinhead oatmeal. The 15th-century Mariota de Ile story is family legend, not documented history

about.text: Caboc is a Scottish cream cheese made from double cream or cream-enriched milk, formed into a log and rolled in toasted pinhead oatmeal. It is rennet-free, with about 67-69 % fat, and is served with oatcakes. It is said to go back to the 15th century and was a cheese of the wealthy, unlike crowdie.

how.label: mature the cream, roll in oatmeal
how.text: Instead of churning the cream into butter it is matured in barrels (maker). Whether cultures are added is not stated; no temperatures given.
